name: recent_high_error_120
change_summary: Shorten the recent high-error teaching pool to 120 days.
aim: Test whether an even more local regime window improves the recent-high-error signal or becomes too sparse.

name: recent_high_error_270
change_summary: Extend the recent high-error teaching pool to 270 days.
aim: Add more high-error UK cases while staying recent enough to preserve the regime-local benefit.

name: recent_high_error_270_case_top2
change_summary: Use a 270-day recent high-error pool but sharpen case controls to two matched examples.
aim: Keep the broader recent hard-case pool while reducing matched-example dilution inside case-conditioned bounds.

name: recent_high_error_365
change_summary: Extend the recent high-error teaching pool to a full 365 days.
aim: Check whether the 35B model benefits from a broader hard-case memory once the pool is restricted to high-error examples.
